cases.email: I was charged $49 twice on the same day last week. One of those needs to be refunded to my card.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was double-charged and requests a refund of one charge.
cases.notes: Canonical duplicate-charge refund case.

cases.email: Your invoice for June lists 12 seats but we only have 9 active users. Please correct and re-issue.
cases.expected_summary: Customer disputes seat count on the June invoice and asks for a corrected invoice.
cases.notes: Invoice dispute, no refund language.

cases.email: How do I switch from monthly to annual billing? Is there a discount?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to switch to annual billing and whether a discount applies.
cases.notes: Billing question phrased as pre-sales; tests category boundary.

cases.email: card declined again?? third time. fix it
cases.expected_summary: Customer's card keeps being declined and they want it resolved.
cases.notes: Very short, angry, no punctuation discipline.

cases.email: Necesito una factura con nuestro tax ID. The one you sent has no VAT number on it.
cases.expected_summary: Customer needs an invoice that includes their tax or VAT identifier.
cases.notes: Mixed-language email; tests robustness.

cases.email: The upgrade page charged me but the plan still shows Starter. Did the payment fail or is this a bug in the upgrade flow?
cases.expected_summary: Customer paid for an upgrade but the plan did not change and wants the charge and plan reconciled.
cases.notes: Billing vs technical: primary blocker is the paid-but-not-upgraded state.

cases.email: Since this morning the API returns 429 for every request even though we are far below our rate limit.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's API calls all return 429 errors despite being under the rate limit.
cases.notes: Classic technical incident report.

cases.email: Webhooks stopped arriving after we rotated our signing secret. Deliveries show as failed with signature mismatch.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's webhooks fail with signature mismatches after rotating the signing secret.
cases.notes: Technical, includes exact error terminology.

cases.email: app slow
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the application is slow.
cases.notes: Two-word email; summary must not hallucinate detail.

cases.email: Ever since teh update the exprot to CSV crashs the borwser tab. Chrome 126, 2GB file.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports that CSV export crashes the browser tab since the update.
cases.notes: Heavy typos; keyword matching alone would struggle.

cases.email: Love the product by the way, but the search index seems to lag about 10 minutes behind new documents. Is that expected or a fault?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether a 10-minute search indexing lag is expected behavior or a fault.
cases.notes: Compliment plus question; category should be technical, not general.

cases.email: Your Salesforce integration writes duplicate contacts whenever a lead has two email addresses. This is corrupting our CRM data.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the Salesforce integration creates duplicate contacts for leads with two email addresses.
cases.notes: Integration bug with data-corruption stakes.

cases.email: I cannot log in since enabling 2FA. The code from my authenticator app is always rejected.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in because their two-factor authentication codes are rejected.
cases.notes: Login issue; account, not technical, by taxonomy.

cases.email: Please transfer ownership of our workspace from priya@acme.com to me. She left the company last Friday.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests workspace ownership transfer from a departed employee to themselves.
cases.notes: Ownership transfer with a security angle.

cases.email: delete my account and all my data. GDPR request.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests account deletion and erasure of their data under GDPR.
cases.notes: Compliance-sensitive deletion request.

cases.email: I upgraded to admin but I still can't see the billing tab. Do admins not get billing access, or is my role broken?
cases.expected_summary: Customer with an admin role cannot access the billing tab and asks whether their permissions are wrong.
cases.notes: Mentions billing but the blocker is role permissions.

cases.email: New hire needs a seat: jordan@acme.com, read-only on Projects, no export rights.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks to provision a read-only seat without export rights for a new employee.
cases.notes: Provisioning request with specific permissions.

cases.email: Do you have an on-prem version? Our security team will not approve a cloud deployment.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether an on-premises deployment option exists.
cases.notes: Pre-sales question.

cases.email: Just wanted to say the new editor is fantastic. Night and day compared to last year.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sends positive feedback about the new editor.
cases.notes: Pure praise; no action needed.

cases.email: Oh great, another redesign. Truly what everyone was asking for instead of dark mode.
cases.expected_summary: Customer sarcastically criticizes the redesign and implies they want dark mode instead.
cases.notes: Sarcasm; naive sentiment reads it as praise.

cases.email: Can I get a copy of your SOC 2 report and a security questionnaire contact for our procurement process?
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests the SOC 2 report and a security contact for procurement.
cases.notes: Compliance/procurement request.

cases.email: hi
cases.expected_summary: Customer sent a greeting with no request.
cases.notes: Degenerate input; classifier must not invent a request.

cases.email: Is there a student discount, and does the free tier include API access? Also your docs page 404s on Safari.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about student discounts and free-tier API access and mentions a broken docs page.
cases.notes: Three topics in one; primary intent is pre-sales.

cases.email: I want a refund because the sync feature has been broken for two weeks and support never answered.
cases.expected_summary: Customer demands a refund because the sync feature has been broken for two weeks.
cases.notes: Technical root cause but the ask is a refund; tie-break rule matters.

cases.email: Password reset emails go to my old address which I no longer control, and I think someone tried to log in from Brazil.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out because reset emails go to an old address and suspects an unauthorized login attempt.
cases.notes: Security-sensitive; account recovery is primary.

cases.email: The invoice PDF download button just spins forever.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot download the invoice PDF because the button loads indefinitely.
cases.notes: Mentions invoice but the blocker is a UI failure.

cases.email: URGENT!!! nothing works, everything broken, also my invoice is wrong and my password expired, call me NOW
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports a broad outage along with invoice and password issues and demands an urgent call.
cases.notes: Kitchen-sink escalation; primary blocker is the outage claim.

cases.email: Following up on ticket 8841. Any update?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for a status update on an existing ticket.
cases.notes: Context-free follow-up; must not guess the original category.
